primary.title: PPF, NSC, KVP or SSY: How many small savings schemes should you have in your investment portfolio
primary.summary: Most investors do not need to hold PPF, NSC, KVP and SSY together, experts say. Choosing one or two schemes based on goals, tax benefits, returns and liquidity can make a portfolio more efficient.
